definitions: A name given to several groups, both real and fictitious.
The Bavarian Illuminati was an Enlightenment-era secret society founded on May 1, 1776.
In modern times, it is commonly used to refer to a supposed shadowy elite organization that conspires to control world affairs.
examples: The Illuminati was founded in Bavaria.
Some believe the Illuminati controls the global economy.
He claimed to be an Illuminati defector.
The symbols were linked to the Illuminati.
